types.name: Edited bank statements
types.check: Each month's opening balance must equal the prior month's closing balance; listed transactions must add up to the summary totals.

types.name: Revenue made up on paper
types.check: Stated annual revenue (application or tax return) is more than 1.5x the annualized deposits in the bank statements.

types.name: Borrowed or fake identity
types.check: Name, date of birth, or address on the photo ID disagrees with the application, beyond common nicknames.

types.name: Same company under a new name
types.check: EIN already used by a different legal name in history.

types.name: Business with no real premises
types.check: Business address is a mailbox store or PMB.

types.name: Party paid somewhere new
types.check: A party that history always paid one way is paired with a different counterparty, especially when funds would go to an account the bank has not used for them. This is a new pattern for a person to review. It is not a confirmed fraud.

types.name: Same person, different business
types.check: Driver license, or SSN last 4 plus birth date, appears under a different business that did not disclose the affiliation. Warning until fraud review confirms it.

types.name: Cross-deal ring
types.check: Unrelated borrowers share several rare attributes (vendor account, preparer, PDF producer, address, phone) at a combined weight that links them. Warning until fraud review confirms it.

types.name: Rare shared pattern
types.check: This deal is unusually close to a cluster of other deals on rare details, closer than the normal similarity limit. Warning until fraud review confirms it.

types.name: Fraud Ops approved pattern
types.check: The deal carries most of the details of a pattern Fraud Operations already marked active.

types.name: Unusual deposit style
types.check: Deposit style is among the most unusual of the current deals and most deposits are round hundreds. Supporting evidence only. Do not write a fraud_detected row for this alone.

types.name: Statement created too early
types.check: A bank statement file was created before the last transaction it lists. Supporting evidence only. Do not write a fraud_detected row for this alone.
